title: Dynamics 365 Sales: ask Sales agent about opportunity research in Microsoft 365 Copilot
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, access controls and licensing statements are supported. The cited Microsoft pages opened successfully, and the briefing correctly distinguishes the documented research tool and underlying agent consumption from details not published for this particular chat feature.
